about: Terraform Registry (registry.terraform.io): search and browse Terraform providers, modules, provider docs, policy libraries and run tasks, and fetch details, versions, download stats and provider binaries through the registry's public v1/v2 JSON APIs and its Algolia search index.

commands.summary: Full-text search over one registry index (providers, modules, provider docs, policy libraries or run tasks) using the site's Algolia search
Search modules by keyword using the public v1 registry API, optionally filtered by provider, namespace or verified status

params.name: provider
params.description: Only modules for this provider, e.g. aws, google, azurerm

params.name: namespace
params.description: Only modules published under this namespace, e.g. terraform-aws-modules

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (max 100) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Browse providers, filtered by tier, category or namespace, with sorting and pagination

params.name: category
params.description: Category slug from list-categories, e.g. database, public-cloud

params.name: namespace
params.description: Only providers from this namespace, e.g. hashicorp

commands.summary: Browse modules, filtered by provider or namespace, with latest version info, sorting and pagination

params.name: provider
params.description: Provider name, e.g. aws, google, azurerm

commands.summary: Get the latest version of a module: description, source, inputs, outputs, resources, submodules and the list of all versions
Get one specific version of a module, including its submodules (v2 API)
List all published versions of a module
Get a module's download counts (week, month, year, total) by its numeric module id

params.name: module_id
params.description: Numeric module id (the 'id' field from list-modules)

commands.summary: Get provider details plus all of its provider-versions (the included versions carry the numeric provider-version ids that list-provider-docs needs)
List every version of a provider with its supported protocols and OS/arch platforms (public v1 API)
Get a provider's download counts (week, month, year, total) by its numeric provider id

params.name: provider_id
params.description: Numeric provider id (the 'id' from list-providers or get-provider, e.g. 323 = hashicorp/aws)

commands.summary: List the documentation pages (resources, data sources, guides, functions) of one provider version

params.name: version_id
params.description: Numeric provider-version id (from get-provider included provider-versions), e.g. 113259 = hashicorp/aws 6.69.1

commands.summary: Look up a provider doc page by provider-version id, category and slug (e.g. the aws_vpc resource) to get its doc id

params.name: slug
params.description: Doc slug: the resource name without the provider prefix, e.g. vpc for aws_vpc

commands.summary: Get the full markdown content of one provider documentation page by doc id

params.name: doc_id
params.description: Numeric provider-doc id (from list-provider-docs or find-provider-doc)

commands.summary: Get the download URL, SHA256 sum and signing keys for a provider binary for a given version, OS and architecture

params.name: os
params.description: Target OS: linux, darwin, windows, freebsd

commands.summary: Browse Sentinel/OPA policy libraries, optionally by namespace, with pagination

params.name: namespace
params.description: Only libraries from this namespace, e.g. hashicorp

commands.summary: Get a policy library's details and its versions
Get one version of a policy library together with the individual policies it contains
Browse HCP Terraform run-task integrations, optionally filtered by category

params.name: category
params.description: Run-task category slug from list-categories --resource run-tasks, e.g. code-quality, drift-detection

commands.summary: List categories (id, name, slug) used to filter providers, policy libraries or run tasks

params.name: resource
params.description: Only categories for this resource type (omit for all)

commands.summary: Get the GitHub profile (name, avatar, location, website, bio) behind a registry namespace

params.name: namespace
params.description: Registry namespace / GitHub login, e.g. hashicorp, terraform-aws-modules
